description: Manifest validation (provider-standard.md §2.4). For each case, apply `patch` (RFC 6902 add, replace and remove) to the named base manifest. `valid` cases pass both steps. `checkedBy: "schema"` cases fail the manifest JSON Schema. `checkedBy: "code"` cases pass the JSON Schema and fail exactly `violations` (in any order) in the checks it can't express. `manifestUrl` is where the manifest was fetched from; a case may override its base's.

services.description: Returns its input unchanged. Useful for testing a client.
